title: LegalRepresentativeCredential
description: Proof of legal representation issued by the National Business Registry of the Republic of Verandia (demo): who may act for a company, revocable the day it ends.

companyName.description: Legal name of the represented company

companyRegistryId.description: Registration number of the company in the National Business Registry

representativeName.description: Full name of the legal representative

role.description: Role of the representative in the company

validUntil.description: Representation expiry date (ISO 8601), empty when unbounded
